name: CTS weekly survey automation coverage
description: Machine-readable map of the CTS weekly process, the evidence expected for each automation or guarded check, and the redundancies that protect risky actions.

scopes.launch: Everything required before the first production SurveyOL invitation batch.
scopes.invitation: Recurring checks around Wednesday-Saturday invitation batches.
scopes.report: Tuesday report, newsletter, and public status update work.
scopes.close: Three-week survey close and final-report work.
scopes.full-cycle: The full weekly process from prep through finalization.

statuses.passed: Completed and no current blocker is known.
statuses.review_required: Ran, but a human review gate is still open.
statuses.blocked: Ran and found a condition that must stop the next risky action.
statuses.missing: No current evidence or manual record was found.
statuses.stale: Evidence exists, but it is older than the freshness window for this step.
statuses.not_due: Explicitly recorded as not due in the current scope.

automations.title: Topic, independent-item, and ballot audit saved
automations.cadence: Before the SurveyOL survey is finalized.
automations.operator_note: Record this after the week-specific item audit note is saved and reviewed.

automations.title: Public placeholder page and reports index are live
automations.cadence: Before the first production invitation batch.
covers: Stable report URL exists before send
Reports index links to the placeholder
automations.operator_note: Record the public URL and git commit after the site is pushed.

automations.title: Public final close date is calculated and posted
automations.cadence: Before the first production invitation batch, after the first batch if the actual send date differs from the plan, and before each report refresh.
covers: First production invitation send date captured or planned
Final close date calculated as first invitation date plus 21 days
Weekly public page shows the exact final close date or a clearly marked final close target before launch
Reports index and refresh notes use the same final close date
Close automation uses the posted final close date
automations.operator_note: Record the first invitation date, computed final close date, public URL, and commit hash. If launch slips, update the public page, reports index, week config, and ledger before reporting the launch complete.

automations.title: SurveyOL no-send suppression list saved
automations.cadence: Before invitation sends and after any send that adds new no-send records.
covers: SurveyOL bounced or delivery-problem suppressions when present
automations.operator_note: Save the current SurveyOL no-send export or normalized CSV to data/private/suppressions/surveyol-no-send.csv.

automations.title: SurveyOL contacts exported and duplicate-audited
automations.cadence: Before importing recipients or sending each invitation batch.
automations.operator_note: Generated by scripts/cts_ops.py surveyol-contacts with --audit-output.

automations.title: Weekly SurveyOL send list, crosswalk, and audit generated
automations.cadence: Before contacts are imported or invitations are sent.
covers: Participant ID and Email Key requirements
automations.operator_note: The audit intentionally opens a human review gate before recipient import or sends.

automations.title: Exact send-list CSV duplicate-email audit passed
automations.cadence: Immediately before importing the weekly send list.
covers: Duplicate normalized email protection in the generated send list
automations.operator_note: Generated by scripts/cts_ops.py audit-email-duplicates --fail-on-duplicates.

automations.title: SurveyOL survey, collectors, pages, questions, and responses snapshotted
automations.cadence: Before launch, before report generation, and before final close.
automations.operator_note: Generated by scripts/cts_ops.py surveyol-snapshot.

automations.title: Weekly SurveyOL survey reviewed and approved by CTS owner
automations.cadence: After the weekly SurveyOL draft is complete and before the first production invitation batch.
covers: CTS owner review of the finished weekly survey
Topic, independent items, ballot, suggestion box, upcoming-topic preview, and invitation copy are acceptable
Invitation may proceed without requiring an internal test send
automations.operator_note: Record that the user reviewed or explicitly approved the finished weekly survey before the first production invitation batch. Do not require a test send unless the user specifically asks for one.

automations.title: SurveyOL missing-contact sync dry-run reviewed
automations.cadence: Before adding SurveyOL contacts.
automations.operator_note: Dry-run plans remain review_required until accepted.

automations.title: SurveyOL contact sync applied or explicitly confirmed unnecessary
automations.cadence: After reviewing the SurveyOL contact sync dry-run.
covers: Human-approved transition from dry-run to actual SurveyOL contact state
automations.operator_note: If no apply was needed, record the reason and reviewer.

automations.title: Closed-test responses quarantined or removed
automations.cadence: Before the first production send.
covers: Production launch starts from clean response state or documented exclusions
automations.operator_note: Record the chosen quarantine path and SurveyOL response count.

automations.title: Email collector automatic reminders are off
automations.cadence: Before the first production invitation batch and before later invitation batches while the collector is open.
covers: No automated reminder is scheduled before invitation-row duplicate audits
Manual reminder flow is the standing reminder path
automations.operator_note: Record this after the production Email collector's Reminder Follow-up setting is verified as Off. Do not use automated 12-day reminders as the weekly default.

automations.title: Manual reminder candidates are invitation-row audited
automations.cadence: Before any manual reminder send; record not_due until the reminder window opens or when no reminders will be sent.
covers: Live invitation rows audited for duplicate normalized emails
Reminder candidate CSV built from unique unsent-reminder rows
Clicked, started, completed, opted-out, bounced, and already-reminded rows excluded
automations.operator_note: Generated by scripts/cts_ops.py build-surveyol-reminder-list, or record not_due until reminder sending is due. A report with human_review_required blocks reminder sending.

automations.title: Manual reminder window checked at day 12
automations.cadence: After the first production invitation date is known, then daily on and after first invitation date plus 12 days until the reminder pass is completed or explicitly skipped.
covers: Manual reminder due date calculated as first invitation date plus 12 days
Reminder workflow triggered as a review-required gate when due
automations.operator_note: Generated by scripts/cts_ops.py surveyol-reminder-due-check. A due result is review_required and should lead to the audited manual reminder flow, not automated reminder follow-up.

automations.title: SurveyOL invitation batch counts recorded
automations.cadence: After every invitation batch until remaining eligible invitations reach zero.
automations.operator_note: Record batch size, cumulative sent count, total eligible invitation-list count, remaining count, and any blockers. Keep respondent links out of the ledger.

automations.title: Live invitation rows duplicate-audited before more sends
automations.cadence: After any SurveyOL invitations exist and before sending more invitations or reminders.
covers: Reminder/send safety after invitation rows already exist
Collector-state audit beyond the contact table
automations.operator_note: Generated by scripts/cts_ops.py audit-surveyol-invitations --fail-on-duplicates after exporting or extracting the live invitation table.

automations.title: Post-send suppression reconciliation recorded
automations.cadence: After each send and before the next recipient import.
automations.operator_note: Record source systems checked and where registry updates were made.

automations.title: Private SurveyOL response export saved
automations.cadence: Before preliminary refreshes and final report generation.
automations.operator_note: Keep raw exports under data/private/ only.

automations.title: Privacy-safe public summary generated
automations.cadence: After response export and quality review inputs are available.
covers: No names, emails, participant IDs, or raw free text
automations.operator_note: Generated by scripts/cts_report_pipeline.py summarize.

automations.title: Generated summary quality section reviewed
automations.cadence: Before publishing each preliminary or final report.
automations.operator_note: Record the quality review result and whether any caveats were published.

automations.title: Static site rebuilt, committed, and pushed
automations.cadence: After changing public report pages or the rolling survey control board.
automations.operator_note: Record the commit hash and public URL verified.

automations.title: Survey close and final report completion recorded
automations.cadence: After the three-week response window closes.
automations.operator_note: Use not_due before the posted final close date; use passed only after finalization is complete.

coverage_areas.title: Survey item quality and ballot integrity
coverage_areas.redundancy_reason: Item audit plus owner prelaunch review prevents unreviewed or off-topic questions from reaching participants.

coverage_areas.title: Global email suppression across SurveyOL and CTS 2026
coverage_areas.redundancy_reason: Suppressions are checked from SurveyOL and the canonical registry rather than trusting a single platform.

coverage_areas.title: Duplicate email protection before imports and sends
coverage_areas.redundancy_reason: The generated send list and live SurveyOL contact table are audited before invitation sends; manual reminder invitation rows are audited before reminder sends.

coverage_areas.title: Private participant identity join
coverage_areas.redundancy_reason: The private crosswalk and response exports support participant identity joins without public identity exposure.

coverage_areas.title: Human review gates before risky external actions
coverage_areas.redundancy_reason: Owner review, dry-run plans, reminder audits, and explicit confirmations make survey launch, list mutation, imports, and sends deliberate rather than silent.

coverage_areas.title: SurveyOL structure, collector, contact, and response state
coverage_areas.redundancy_reason: Survey snapshots, owner review, contact exports, launch quarantine checks, automatic-reminder-off verification, and manual reminder audits catch different SurveyOL failure modes.

coverage_areas.title: Private/raw data boundary
coverage_areas.redundancy_reason: Raw exports stay private, public summaries are aggregate-only, and quality review is recorded before publication.

coverage_areas.title: Public report and rolling status board accuracy
coverage_areas.redundancy_reason: Public pages, the control board, commit evidence, and finalization records all have to agree.

coverage_areas.title: Survey close-date calculation and publication
coverage_areas.redundancy_reason: The final close date is calculated from the first invitation send, published on public pages, checked during report refreshes, and reused when the collector is closed.

coverage_areas.title: Invitation batch accountability
coverage_areas.redundancy_reason: Batch counts, automatic-reminder-off verification, manual reminder audit evidence, and suppression reconciliation are recorded separately so a send cannot disappear into platform history.

coverage_areas.title: Report generation and quality checks
coverage_areas.redundancy_reason: The private export, public aggregate JSON, explicit quality review, and published site update are checked separately.
